tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Main pane background: transcript, settings pages. Tailwind `bg-background`.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text on background, sidebar, card, muted and popover.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Left rail behind the agent list. One step away from background so the rail reads without a heavy border.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: composer, expanded tool call, dialogs. Pair with border, and shadow-lg only for the composer and popovers.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, command palette, tooltips.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Agent message bubbles, the thinking pill, wells for code and tool output, the selected pinned tile.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ghost buttons and sidebar rows (shadcn meaning: a hover surface, not a brand hue).

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, slugs, model names, tool summaries, placeholders. Reads on background, sidebar, card, muted and accent.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Edges of text fields, checkboxes and secondary buttons: 4.5:1 or more on background and card in both themes (3:1 is the floor for control borders; kept higher so fields read clearly).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px offset in the surface colour.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and the user's own message pill: the inverted, black-on-light / white-on-dark accent. Alias of foreground.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and failed runs: text, icons, the error dot. Always next to a word.

tokens.name: destructive-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error badges and failed tool calls; destructive text reads on it.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: An agent that is active and reachable; links; the unread count. The only cool hue in the system.

tokens.name: live-soft
tokens.usage: Background of live badges; live text reads on it.

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: A run in progress, an alarm firing, a tool executing. Text, dot and spinner; pairs with the word 実行中.

tokens.name: running-soft
tokens.usage: Background of running badges; running text reads on it.

tokens.name: agent-orange
tokens.usage: Agent identity hue, kept soft (lower chroma) so it sits with the monochrome UI: the bird's head, back, wing and tail, and the flag on its birdhouse roof. Always shown beside the agent's name.

tokens.name: agent-ink
tokens.usage: The main agent's bird (the seeded assistant): a deep warm charcoal in both themes. Avatars look identical in light and dark.

tokens.name: agent-system
tokens.usage: Dedicated (system) agents such as system:memory: a quiet grey bird.

tokens.name: bird-face
tokens.usage: Every bird's face and belly: a warm white in both themes.

tokens.name: bird-eye
tokens.usage: Eyes and closed-eye lines on bird-face.

tokens.name: bird-blush
tokens.usage: Cheeks, two separate lobes drawn at 60% opacity.

tokens.name: bird-beak
tokens.usage: Lower half of the short wedge bill: a soft coral that does not compete with the status colours.

tokens.name: bird-beak-top
tokens.usage: Upper half of the beak, for a little depth.

tokens.name: bird-feet
tokens.usage: Legs and three-toed feet, drawn as 1.35px strokes.

tokens.name: bird-bill-line
tokens.usage: The thin seam between the upper and lower bill.

tokens.name: house-wood
tokens.usage: Front of every birdhouse: a light grey from the same family as the UI's muted surfaces, so the house reads as part of the interface. Still darker than bird-face in light and lighter than the background in dark.

tokens.name: house-wood-side
tokens.usage: Side wall of the birdhouse, one step darker than house-wood.

tokens.name: house-roof
tokens.usage: Roof edge and flag pole: a mid grey. Shared by all agents; the agent's hue is only the flag.

tokens.name: house-roof-side
tokens.usage: Back slope of the roof.

tokens.name: house-post
tokens.usage: Post and perch.

tokens.name: house-hole
tokens.usage: Entrance hole.

families.sans: "Gen Interface JP", "Hiragino Sans", "Noto Sans JP", system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: "Gen Interface JP Display", "Gen Interface JP", "Hiragino Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: type-2xl
styles.usage: Page titles in settings and empty states. Tailwind `text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight`.

styles.name: type-lg
styles.usage: Pane header and the main agent's name. `text-lg font-semibold`.

styles.name: type-base
styles.sample: 長く走り続けるエージェントのための、静かなコンソール。
styles.usage: Default UI text: sidebar names, buttons, tool rows, pane titles, the composer input (16px also stops iOS zoom). `text-base`.

styles.name: type-base-semibold
styles.usage: Buttons, the selected sidebar row, agent and tool names. `text-base font-semibold`.

styles.name: type-prose
styles.sample: 調査を続けています。3件の資料を読み終え、残りは明日の朝に再開します。
styles.usage: Transcript messages: Japanese needs the taller leading. `text-base leading-7`.

styles.name: type-sm
styles.usage: Dense parts and secondary lines: menu items, settings rows, tabs, memory items, the second line of sidebar rows. `text-sm`.

styles.name: type-xs
styles.usage: Meta: badges, timestamps, small headings, counts. `text-xs`.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Tool arguments and results, config JSON. `font-mono text-sm`.

styles.name: mono-xs
styles.usage: Agent UUID prefixes, request IDs, durations. `font-mono text-xs`.

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px step (`--spacing: 0.25rem`). Names match the utility number: spacing-4 is p-4.

tokens.name: spacing-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in badges; dot-to-text gap.

tokens.name: spacing-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; sidebar row vertical padding; icon-to-label in buttons.

tokens.name: spacing-3
tokens.usage: Sidebar row horizontal padding; tool call padding; composer inner padding.

tokens.name: spacing-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; pane header padding; gap between a message and its tool calls.

tokens.name: spacing-6
tokens.usage: Gap between turns in the transcript; page gutter.

tokens.name: spacing-8
tokens.usage: Gap between transcript turns from different speakers; section spacing in settings.

tokens.name: spacing-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state top margin; space above the composer at the end of a transcript.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, kbd, small chips. `rounded-sm`.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, menu items. `rounded-md`.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, sidebar rows, tool calls. `rounded-lg`.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, dialogs. `rounded-xl`.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Composer and user message bubble. `rounded-2xl`.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, the round send button, avatars. `rounded-full`.

shadow.note: Surfaces are separated by tone and hairlines; shadows mark only things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Composer, popovers, menus, the command palette.
